screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Some money you can't hold in your hand.

cards.caption: A card can pay. The money waits at the bank.
A phone can pay too. Same money, no coins.

screens.prompt: Kofi's mum pays with a card. Is that real money?
screens.pennyHint: Think about where the money is kept, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! The money sits at the bank. The card moves it.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The card moves real money out of the bank.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about that card again, {name}.

screens.prompt: Which of these can pay at a shop?
screens.pennyHint: Ask yourself: would a shop take it, {name}?
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! A shop takes money, not the things it sells.
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Coins, notes, cards and phones can all pay.

screens.story: Sana's dad taps his phone at the shop. The screen says PAID.
screens.prompt: Where did that money come from?
screens.pennyHint: Money can wait in a bank, {name}.

options.label: From the bank, where his money is kept
options.outcome: Yes. The phone asked the bank to send the money to the shop.

options.label: From inside the phone
options.outcome: There are no coins inside a phone. It only sends a message.

options.label: From nowhere. It was free
options.outcome: It wasn't free. Real money left his bank.

screens.rightMessage: That's it, {name}! The phone asks the bank to pay.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! A phone holds no coins. The money is at the bank.

screens.prompt: You want a game on a tablet. What do you do first?
screens.pennyHint: I curl up when real money is close by, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Card money is real money. Always ask a grown-up.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! That would spend real money. Stop, and ask a grown-up.
screens.retryIntro: One more time, {name}. What comes first?

screens.title: Lesson done, {name}!
screens.message: Cards and phones move real money. Now you know.
